hypotheses.C1_top16_physical_core_is_stable: Relative to the head split, every split's top-16 physical output, tangent, and context Tucker subspaces have projector overlap at least 0.70.
hypotheses.C2_tucker16_recovers_score_paths: Every split's Tucker-16 quotient retains at least 0.80 prediction and target fidelity on every external corpus.
hypotheses.C3_tucker32_is_score_sufficient: Every split's Tucker-32 quotient retains at least 0.90 prediction and target fidelity on every external corpus.
hypotheses.C4_tucker32_recovers_margin: Every split's Tucker-32 quotient retains at least 0.60 margin fidelity on every external corpus.
hypotheses.C5_tucker32_is_split_stable: Across split choices, every external endpoint's Tucker-32 fidelity range is at most 0.08.
hypotheses.C6_tucker_tensor_execution_is_exact: Direct execution of every split's contracted Tucker-32 tensor matches projected native CP execution to relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.C7_tensor_axes_are_not_claimed_canonical: Results are reported as physical subspaces; no sign, permutation, or individual HOSVD-axis identity claim is made.
